_comment: Source manifest for the One-OS Device DB generator.
Every profile must cite one of these source ids, and every profile whose only
citation is reference-only material is REJECTED by the builder rather than
shipped. This is the machine-checkable half of the provenance gate in
reuse_class records how material from this source may be used:
copy          verbatim data is permitted under the recorded license
port          semantics may be re-implemented in our own form
clean_room    an independent implementation from published behaviour
reference_only usable to understand a protocol, never to emit records
permitted_for_output must be true before any record may be derived. A source
with permitted_for_output=false is treated as reference-only even if its
reuse_class says otherwise, so a license review can revoke output without

sources.name: one-os-owned-fixtures
sources.note: Profiles authored for One-OS from the format specification and public Bluetooth SIG / Connectivity Standards Alliance assignments. No third-party database content.

sources.name: home-assistant-zeroconf-ssdp-matchers
sources.note: Behavioural reference for mDNS/SSDP service naming. Not yet reviewed for output, so any profile citing only this is rejected.

sources.name: zha-device-handlers
sources.note: Declarative quirk reference. Fingerprint data may be portable under Apache-2.0 but has not been reviewed, so it is currently reference-only.

sources.name: theengs-decoder
sources.note: GPL-derived material. Usable to understand a BLE payload layout; a clean-room decoder must be written before shipping anything derived from it.

sources.name: one-os-owned-captures
sources.note: Reserved for captures taken with our own hardware. Empty until a board is available; listed so provenance can cite it later without a format change.
